services.name: Yoga class
services.desc: A gentle midday gathering in sisterhood - a space to soften, land and return to yourself through the quiet language of the rose. This weekly meditation is a rose-infused journey inward: slowing down, tuning into your body and opening a little more gently to the wisdom of your heart. Through breath, visualization, embodied stillness and gentle movement, we journey through the unfolding petals of the inner rose - softening the heart, connecting to our womb and remembering the beauty held within. services.name: Weekly Hand-Building Pottery
services.desc: A beginner-friendly hand-building pottery drop-in that will help you build your skills and create a unique projects over two sessions that can be flexibly booked at your leisure. Session fee includes both sessions required to complete one project, in addition to all supplies needed and an instructor on site for assistance. During the first session, you will learn how to slab roll, form, cut, and press clay in order to create a unique project, with some inspiration pictured below. We will always provide guidance and ideas, but the masterpiece will be entirely your own.
